departures.name: Aubrey McMillan
departures.note: Listed PGY-I Oct 2017 to May 2018 (and in the stale Aug 2018 capture); gone by Feb 2019. NPPES taxonomy is neuroradiology/diagnostic radiology (OH), and a 2023 PubMed paper lists CWRU/MetroHealth Radiology. Switched to radiology. PHASE 2: recorded switched_specialty (radiology) from PMID 36598827/37356490.

departures.name: Sean McDougall
departures.note: PGY-1 Feb-Aug 2019 (2018 class with Lagman and Mauria). Absent from the UH page Dec 2019; the frozen case.edu page still shows him as PGY-1 in Dec 2019, so he may have repeated or left during 2019-20. NPPES 'other_specialty' match is a 2016 Texas nurse practitioner, probably a different person. Outcome unknown. PHASE 2: probable switch to NEUROLOGY - PubMed 2025 PMID 40899253 (Dept of Neurology, Cedars-Sinai) and NPPES Sean McDougall MD neurology/neurocritical care, enumerated 2018-03-30 (same month as co-intern Lagman's NPI). Recorded switched_specialty, moderate confidence.

departures.name: Carlito Lagman
departures.note: PGY-3 Nov 2020 (also in the stale Sep 2021 capture). Absent Dec 2023, when he would have been PGY-6. Left during the unobserved 2021-22/2022-23 window. PubMed has UH/CWRU neurosurgery affiliation up to 2021, then 2023 'Encino Surgicenter, Los Angeles' and 2024 'Research Fellow, Los Angeles'. Not on the alumni list. Outcome unknown. PHASE 2: exit year still unobservable (Jul 2021-Dec 2023). 2023-24 papers are plastic/aesthetic surgery research in Los Angeles; recorded departure_type unknown.

departures.name: Shaleeka Cornelius
departures.note: PGY-1 Nov 2020 to Sep 2021 (the Sep 2021 capture is stale). Absent Dec 2023. Exact year unknown (2021-22 or 2022-23). NPPES primary taxonomy is emergency medicine (FL). Probably switched specialty. PHASE 2: NPPES enumerated 2020-04 (intern timing), EM Port Charlotte FL; no publication/program page confirms EM, so recorded departure_type unknown (probable EM).

joiners.name: Christina Huang Wright
joiners.note: Transferred from USC on July 1, 2014 (casemed newsnewresidents.cfm). Graduated 2020. PHASE 2: not on the USC neurosurgery roster (program 104) in 2013-14, so the USC year was probably preliminary/another department. Transfer-in row recorded.

adjudication_summary.caveats: Phase 2 rerun: McMillan and McDougall SWITCHED (radiology; neurology, moderate confidence); Lagman and Cornelius LEFT, destination unknown (Cornelius probable EM by NPPES only). Mauria (2025) and the Defta class (2026) are PGY-terminal roster graduations.

problems: 2013-14 and 2022-23 stay significant (no roster exists in Wayback or any Common Crawl crawl). 2021-22 reconstructed but low. Lagman and Cornelius exit years unknown. The case.edu roster was frozen after 2019 and must not be used. No Common Crawl failures in phase 2.

2012-2013.reason: Only a spring capture (Mar 2013); every name is bracketed by 2011-12 and 2014-15, and the 2012 class (Ostergard, Wu) is intact later.

2013-2014.reason: No roster capture Mar 2013-Oct 2014 (Wayback + all 2013-2014 CC crawls, incl. the retried 2013-20). Huang Wright was taken as a PGY2 transfer into the 2013 class on Jul 1 2014, which may mean a 2013 intern left unseen during 2013-14.

2021-2022.reason: No roster capture (Wayback + all 2021-2023 CC crawls). All four 2021 interns (the largest class the program has had) reappear as PGY3 in Dec 2023, Shah/Chakraborty/Sunshine have UH neurosurgery affiliations on 2022-23 papers; Lagman and Cornelius exits are already counted, only their exact year is unknown.

2022-2023.reason: No roster capture. The 2022 class shows only Sirinit (other classes 2-4), so an intern who entered Jul 2022 and left before Dec 2023 would be invisible.

terminal_pgy_note: 7-year program throughout. Tomac, Munyon and Onwuzulike (pre-2011 entrants) finished after years listed as PGY-6; they are completions, not departures.
